name: Density and Temperature Bias Initialization
definition: Initializes the bias of the last layer of the neural network to the midpoint of the log density bounds (and optionally log temperature bounds) to ensure the network starts predicting values within the valid range.
summary: Density and Temperature Bias Initialization sets a NeRF's final layer bias to the midpoint of log-space density and temperature bounds, ensuring a transparent start and differing from alpha-invariance methods by targeting log-space parameters.
